caveat: Precision/recall against ground truth cannot be computed: the subtypes are derived from NLI scores, not independent human labels. nli_signal_rate describes whether the gate had NLI evidence for its blocking decision, not whether the blocked answer was actually wrong.
finding: Of 32 in-domain answers, 21 were blocked by the gate (coverage 34%). Of those, 13 had an NLI contradiction signal (62% of blocked). The remaining 7 (blocked_neutral) were blocked because faithfulness=0 with no contradiction signal — NLI assigned near-zero scores in both directions (domain mismatch on procurement numbers). 5 answers passed cleanly; 7 passed despite mixed NLI signals (entailed AND contradicted).
